WITH counts AS (
  SELECT a.link_to_member, m.position, COUNT(*) as attendance_count
  FROM attendance a
  INNER JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
  GROUP BY a.link_to_member, m.position
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(attendance_count) as total_count FROM counts
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    c.link_to_member as member_id,
    c.position,
    c.attendance_count,
    CAST(c.attendance_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as share
  FROM counts c
  CROSS JOIN totals t
),
ranked_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY share DESC) as rn
  FROM shares
),
tenth_share_subquery AS (
  SELECT share FROM ranked_shares WHERE rn = 10
)
SELECT member_id, position, attendance_count, share
FROM ranked_shares
WHERE rn <= 10 
   OR share IN (SELECT share FROM tenth_share_subquery)
ORDER BY share DESC
